spec.cases: Only master dataset training cases with exactly21 bars; reserved validation not used.
spec.coefficient: y0=mean(target bars0..19), y1=mean(target bars1..20); alpha=(y1-y0)/(driver_bar20-y0). Equivalent least-squares one-update fit y1=y0+alpha*(driver20-y0).
spec.admissibility: Denominator nonzero; coefficient (raw or absolute per fixed policy) must satisfy0<alpha<=1. No clipping or per-case fallback in long branch.
spec.mapping: N=2/alpha-1; C=K*dt*N, one positiveK shared by all eleven trainingC21, generous observedC+/-1second intervals.
spec.short_branch: Previously observed short relationship retained only as reference; matching its cutoff does not establish original mechanism.
spec.gate: Reject incomplete coverage or empty commonK interval. Only survivors may be tested on other training lengths before reserved validation.
spec.scope: 32 finite candidates, known overlapping training labels. Exploratory. Does not exclude all rolling20 calculations, external series, initialization or postEND data.
